geometry.benchmark: Full Set5/Set14/BSD100/Urban100; independent top-left modcrop per scale, PIL bicubic, output clamp [0,1], Y-PSNR using coefficients [65.738,129.057,25.064]/256 and shave=scale. Not stage17 common-modcrop torch-bicubic geometry.
geometry.recovery: DIV2K0869-0900 center240 RGB crops, torch antialiased bicubic/clamped LR, unclipped prediction, shave4, non-DC FFT with width .25 in u=2*s*r; includes exact Nyquist outer ring.
geometry.R_aggregation: For each seed/bin first sum error and target over 32 images, compute 1-sum(error)/sum(target), then average two seeds. Regional metric remains the unweighted mean of quarter-u-bin delta_R; no hidden region-energy pooling.
geometry.policy_labels: Rows called native in the constant arm still execute its fixed training constant internally; no-cell ignores the passed cell.

interpretation_limits: T1 point estimate must be at least .05 dB, but its confidence interval only has to exclude zero; not a confidence lower bound of .05 dB.
T2 requires an entire 95% interval within +/- .03 dB. Failure is not evidence of difference or equivalence.
Image uncertainty conditions on two trained seeds; dataset-balanced means give Set5 and Urban100 equal total weight.

Per-image Y-PSNR aggregation and stored spectral statistics are independently recomputed. No saved predictions exist to independently rerun the Y conversion numerically; that portion is frozen-source/geometry verification.
Correct pairing can help this recipe without identifying a unique internal mechanism; constant changes the feature distribution and shuffle injects noise.

shuffle_benchmark_policy_variation.definition: Dataset/scale-balanced mean of image PSNR metrics; six fixed inference policies. SD is descriptive dispersion across policies, not uncertainty across trained seeds.
shuffle_benchmark_policy_variation.inference_rule: Each marginal c is the SHA256-derived 96/round(48*(1+3*v)) from frozen evaluate.py, held constant across scales for that image. This is source-verified, not a logged per-query readback.

supplemental_descriptive_only.CI_scope: Pointwise paired percentile95%, descriptive and unadjusted; not new confirmatory tests.
